text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, you should eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and drink enough water. Regular exercise is also important; even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Don't forget to get enough sleep, because rest helps your body recover and improves your mood. Mental health matters just as much as physical health, so take time to relax and talk to friends when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance by setting clear limits between your job and your free time.
